title: ZZX-Labs DeadOPop Dead Coins Registry
description: Canonical DeadOPop registry of failed, defunct, shutdown, scam, rug-pulled, fraudulent, collapsed, abandoned, bankrupt, insolvent, delisted-dead, protocol-failure, exchange-failure, and effectively zeroed-out cryptoassets. Entries may remain in the registry while loss quantification is pending.

methodology.counting: Every validated failed/dead asset counts once, regardless of whether a loss estimate is available.
methodology.valuation: Prefer sourced direct investor/protocol/creditor loss when defensible. Otherwise use explicitly labeled market-cap destruction estimates.
methodology.double_counting: Do not sum overlapping victim losses, creditor shortfalls, exploit losses, and market-cap destruction for the same economic failure. Use one primary estimated_value_lost_usd per registry entry and preserve alternate evidence in notes/sources.
methodology.automatic_discovery: New reports enter a candidate/evidence queue. Automatic promotion requires a strong failure signal plus either an authoritative source or at least two independent publisher domains.

entries.name: BitConnect
entries.failure_reason: BitConnect shut its lending/exchange platform after regulatory pressure; the lending program was prosecuted as a global crypto Ponzi scheme.

sources.label: U.S. Department of Justice BitConnect prosecution records

entries.notes: Uses approximately $2.4B of reported victim loss rather than blindly using peak market capitalization.

entries.name: OneCoin
entries.failure_reason: OneCoin was exposed and prosecuted as a fraudulent cryptocurrency/Ponzi-style scheme with no genuine public blockchain.

sources.label: U.S. Department of Justice OneCoin prosecution records

entries.notes: OneCoin was not a legitimate decentralized coin; included because it was sold as a cryptocurrency and caused large investor losses.

entries.name: PlusToken
entries.failure_reason: PlusToken collapsed after operators of the wallet/investment scheme disappeared or were arrested; authorities described it as a large crypto Ponzi scheme.
entries.notes: Approximate value of crypto reported as controlled/lost through the scheme; not a token-market-cap estimate.

entries.name: WoToken
entries.failure_reason: WoToken was prosecuted in China as a multi-level cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme.
entries.notes: Rounded estimate based on widely reported value of assets taken by the scheme.

entries.name: Pincoin / iFan
entries.failure_reason: Vietnam-based Modern Tech's Pincoin and iFan ICO schemes collapsed amid allegations that approximately 32,000 investors were defrauded.
entries.notes: Combined scheme entry prevents double-counting the widely reported $660M total across both related ICOs.

entries.notes: Uses court/restitution-scale loss rather than the token's much larger and less reliable peak capitalization.

entries.name: TerraUSD
entries.failure_reason: TerraUSD lost its dollar peg and entered a death spiral with LUNA, destroying most of its market value.
entries.notes: Loss is deliberately allocated rather than simply summing peak capitalization with LUNA and double-counting the full Terra ecosystem collapse.

entries.name: Terra (old LUNA / Luna Classic)
entries.failure_reason: The original LUNA token hyperinflated and collapsed during the TerraUSD death spiral.
entries.notes: Uses a conservative allocation of Terra ecosystem destruction to avoid double-counting UST plus LUNA peak market caps.

entries.name: FTX Token
entries.failure_reason: FTT's utility and value collapsed when FTX entered bankruptcy after a liquidity crisis and revelations about balance-sheet practices.
entries.notes: Counts token market-value destruction, not FTX creditor claims.

entries.name: Celsius

entries.notes: Token-market-value estimate; does not add Celsius creditor losses separately.

entries.name: Voyager Token

entries.name: Serum
entries.failure_reason: The original Serum DEX became effectively defunct after FTX's collapse because upgrade authority was compromised/controlled by FTX-linked keys; community forks replaced it.

sources.label: Archived reporting on Serum after FTX collapse

entries.notes: Original project considered defunct; later community infrastructure is distinct.

entries.notes: Approximation based on widely reported value involved in the Iron Finance collapse; not a realized-loss audit.
